title: Static review session accounting
description: Opt-in, one real Pi review of a tiny local Git fixture through an isolated production gateway. Requires an authenticated Pi LiteLLM provider and a new private output directory. No live farm or publication writes.

review-usage.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_USAGE=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_ROUNDS=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUNNER=pi FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_MODEL=litellm/glm-5p3-flash FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_EFFORT=none node --import tsx scripts/runner-validation/gateway/slotless-review-retention.mts "$FARMSLOT_REVIEW_USAGE_PROOF_OUTPUT"
review-usage.intent: A new slotless Pi review returns its exact conversation, tokens and estimated cost through authenticated run.get.
